nodes.label: Server.Run — listener
nodes.desc: Server.Run (server.go L506) accepts TCP connections; newConn (L294) wraps each one as a clientConn with a TiDBContext session.

nodes.label: clientConn — MySQL wire
nodes.desc: clientConn.Run (conn.go L1157) reads packet loop; dispatch (L1444) routes commands; handleQuery (L1864) runs COM_QUERY SQL text.

nodes.label: session.ExecuteStmt
nodes.desc: session.ExecuteStmt (session.go L2489) and Execute (L1947) drive one statement: parse, plan, execute, commit via doCommitWithRetry (L817).

nodes.label: Optimize — plan cache + costing
nodes.desc: Optimize (optimize.go L148) checks the plan cache, then builds and cost-optimizes a logical/physical plan for each statement.

nodes.label: PlanBuilder.Build
nodes.desc: PlanBuilder.Build (planbuilder.go L601) turns the AST into logical plans; buildSelect (logical_plan_builder.go L4349) handles SELECT.

nodes.label: executorBuilder.build
nodes.desc: newExecutorBuilder (builder.go L154) and build (L195) translate the physical plan into a tree of Executor objects.

nodes.label: Executor.Next tree
nodes.desc: Executor interface (executor.go L51) with Next (L63) pulls chunk.Row batches up the volcano-style tree.

nodes.label: RequestBuilder — kv.Request
nodes.desc: RequestBuilder.Build (request_builder.go L61) with SetDAGRequest (L203) and SetHandleRanges (L156) packages key ranges + DAG operators into kv.Request.

nodes.label: distsql.Select
nodes.desc: Select (distsql.go L62) and SelectWithRuntimeStats (L174) launch parallel coprocessor requests and stream results back.

nodes.label: copIterator — region tasks
nodes.desc: buildCopTasks (coprocessor.go L529) splits ranges per region; copIterator (L990) Next (L1441) runs them concurrently.

nodes.label: tikvStore / tikvTxn → TiKV
nodes.desc: tikvStore (tikv_driver.go L327) implements kv.Storage; tikvTxn (txn_driver.go L47) commits through the tikv/client-go two-phase commit protocol.
